scripts.pipeline:lint: uv run --project apps/pipeline ruff check apps/pipeline
scripts.pipeline:format: uv run --project apps/pipeline ruff format --check apps/pipeline
scripts.pipeline:typecheck: uv run --project apps/pipeline ty check apps/pipeline
scripts.quality:pipeline: pnpm run pipeline:lint && pnpm run pipeline:format && pnpm run pipeline:typecheck && pnpm run pipeline:test && pnpm run pipeline:coverage
scripts.quality:all: pnpm run quality:pipeline && pnpm run affected:lint && pnpm run affected:format && pnpm run affected:typecheck && pnpm run affected:test && pnpm run affected:coverage && pnpm run affected:duplication
